name: Bow and arrow
summary: Upright wooden recurve bow with an arrow nocked on the string; anim draw pulls the string back and releases.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the bow's grip

params.name: y
params.note: bottom tip of the bow rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 620 px tall and 260 px wide at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: draw = the string is pulled back and the arrow snaps forward, looping
